description: Trims UI - Designer can define physical trim SKUs per template with quantity rules (TRIM_BY_ZONE_PERIMETER, TRIM_BY_PANEL_EDGE, TRIM_BY_LENGTH, TRIM_FIXED) and fixed quantity values, per spec section 52.
steps: Create directory frontend/src/components/Trims/ with files: TrimsPanel.tsx, AddTrimDialog.tsx, index.ts, and __tests__/ directory.

In TrimsPanel.tsx: Follow HiddenComponentsPanel.tsx pattern. Accept templateId prop. Check CanvasMode.DESIGNER. Fetch from 'template_trim' table using fromTable('template_trim').select('*').eq('template_id', templateId). Display each trim entry showing: sku_id (nullable - show 'Geometry only' if null), trim_type badge (GEOMETRY in grey, PHYSICAL in blue), quantity_rule, and fixed_quantity (only shown for TRIM_FIXED rule). Include 'Add Trim' button. Use data-testid='trims-panel', data-testid='add-trim-btn', data-testid='no-trims-msg', data-testid='trim-item-{id}', data-testid='trim-type-{id}'.

In AddTrimDialog.tsx: Follow AddHiddenComponentDialog pattern. Fields: SKU ID (text input, optional for GEOMETRY type), Trim Type (select: GEOMETRY, PHYSICAL), Quantity Rule (select: TRIM_BY_ZONE_PERIMETER, TRIM_BY_PANEL_EDGE, TRIM_BY_LENGTH, TRIM_FIXED), Fixed Quantity (number input, only shown when quantity_rule is TRIM_FIXED). Validation: if trim_type is PHYSICAL, sku_id is required. Insert into 'template_trim' table. Use data-testid='add-trim-dialog', data-testid='sku-id-input', data-testid='trim-type-select', data-testid='quantity-rule-select', data-testid='fixed-quantity-input', data-testid='confirm-btn', data-testid='cancel-btn', data-testid='write-error'.
In index.ts: Export TrimsPanel and AddTrimDialog.

Create __tests__/TrimsPanel.test.tsx following HiddenComponentsPanel.test.tsx pattern. Mock fromTable to return sample trim data with both trim types and multiple quantity rules. Test: renders in DESIGNER mode, hidden in CONSULTANT mode, displays items after fetch, shows correct trim type badges, shows fixed_quantity only for TRIM_FIXED, shows 'Geometry only' when sku_id is null, shows empty state, opens dialog on button click. Minimum 8 test cases.
acceptance_criteria: TrimsPanel renders in DESIGNER mode and is hidden in CONSULTANT mode
Panel fetches and displays template_trim entries with trim_type, quantity_rule, sku_id, fixed_quantity
Trim type is shown as a color-coded badge (GEOMETRY/PHYSICAL)
Fixed quantity is only shown when quantity_rule is TRIM_FIXED
Add button opens AddTrimDialog which enforces: PHYSICAL requires sku_id, TRIM_FIXED shows fixed_quantity field
Dialog inserts into template_trim table with correct fields
All new tests pass along with existing tests
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run src/components/Trims/__tests__/
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
findings: All 13 new tests pass. Full suite: 700 tests pass. TypeScript strict mode clean. TrimType and TrimQuantityRule types exported from TrimsPanel.tsx for reuse by AddTrimDialog.
